title: User and Entitlement Changes Report
description: Database account, role, and privilege changes.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('CREATE USER','ALTER USER','DROP USER','GRANT','REVOKE','CREATE ROLE','ALTER ROLE','DROP ROLE','SET ROLE') | fields Time, 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Operation', 'Target User', 'Object Owner', 'Object Name', 'Operation Status' | sort -Time
